scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:search && npm run verify:search
scripts.build:search: npm run prepare:search-manifest && node scripts/search/build-index.mjs --manifest .cache/fulltext-search-manifest.json --output dist/search
scripts.test: npm run verify:masters && node --test tests/archive.test.mjs && npm run test:search
scripts.test:search: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_search_*.py' && node --test tests/fulltext-search.test.mjs
scripts.verify:search: node scripts/search/verify-index.mjs --directory dist/search && node scripts/search/verify-queries.mjs --directory dist/search
